escena: SCENE (review at a storefront, Mexico City, golden hour): the photograph is taken from the STREET, THROUGH the shop window, so TWO REALITIES OVERLAP in one frame — verify it by these landmarks: inside, the two of them lean over a printed layout, sharp and clearly readable; and ACROSS THE SAME GLASS, the reflection of the street behind the camera is superimposed over them: the facade opposite, a passing cyclist and the low sun, all visible AT THE SAME TIME as the people inside, neither one hiding the other. The low sun behind the camera makes the reflection strong. He wears a faded olive linen shirt; she wears a fine light heather-grey knit sweater; no navy or blue clothing. Neither looks at the camera, caught at the instant she points at the layout. 50mm at f/2.8, focus on the two inside. Everything is completely unbranded, no readable text anywhere.

lecho.objeto: the lower aluminium frame of the shop window right against the lens
